tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Amino Acid Sequences of ACE2-Antagonist Peptidesa
footnotes: Theoretical and experimental molecular weight, half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) using a luciferase assay and binding affinities of SARS-CoV-2:ACE2-antagonist peptides (determined using) MST are also shown. Peptides were synthesized on solid phase using the F-moc strategy, have a free N-terminus, and are amidated at the C-terminus.
